title: Gateway rejects the unit ID
summary: Behind a gateway, the unit ID selects the target device; a wrong unit ID is answered with an exception.

sections.heading: Recognize it
sections.body: The gateway answers quickly, but with exception 0Bh (gateway target device failed to respond) or 0Ah (gateway path unavailable), depending on the gateway.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Compare the configured unit ID with the gateway's routing table in its documentation. Directly addressed TCP devices often ignore the unit ID; gateways do not.

modeled: Deterministic Modbus TCP client and servers: IPv4 subnet rules, address resolution, unit ID handling of gateways, function 03/04 reads, exceptions 01/02/0B, processing time against the configured timeout, INT and REAL values with word order
approximated: One request at a time per connection
omitted: Writes, other function codes and serial bus timing behind gateways
Byte order inside a register (words are big-endian as the protocol defines)

troubleshooting.effect: No data from the device behind the gateway
diagnosticMethod: Compare the unit ID with the documentation
troubleshooting.explanation: An exception is an answer: the path works, the request is wrong.
